prompt.v: Circle O has radius 10 cm, and the area of sector AOB is 10π cm². What is ∠AOB, in degrees?

problems.explain: The whole circle’s area is πr² = 100π, and the sector is 10π of it: 10/100 of the circle. That share of 360° is 10 ÷ 100 × 360 = 36°. (Not 10 × 360: the share is the sector over the whole.) So ∠AOB = 36°.
